caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, shown in three-quarter view. The chest features two square cabinet doors on the upper section, each door containing a centered red square panel framed by lighter and darker wood tones. The upper edge and corners of the cabinet are decorated with carved details and small, turned vertical columns. Below the cabinet doors are four drawers arranged in two rows. The two upper drawers have decorative geometric patterns with black and tan inlays, featuring central black knobs. The lower two drawers are similarly decorated but with additional rectangular frames of alternating wood tones and also have central black knobs. The sides of the chest are plain, comprised of three rectangular recessed panels. The overall coloration of the chest is composed of various shades of brown, tan, black, and red, with the wood grain visibly rendered throughout the structure. The chest stands on four short, rectangular legs, and the background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Chest of Drawers
